## Workflow 1 — Index Refresh

Nightly 02:00 Manila. Handoff §7 Workflow 1.

Reads both channels for messages newer than the
stored watermarks, upserts into `posty_qu_index`,
advances the watermarks.

**Writes only CHANGED rows, never the whole index.**
A blind appendOrUpdate over every row would
overwrite `posted_date` with a re-announcement's
newer date — exactly what §7 step 4 forbids, since
aging must run from the FIRST announcement.

**The logic lives in `code/build-index.js`** and is
tested by `./scripts/test-nodes` (35 checks).
Edit there, re-run the tests, then paste back.
Never edit only the node.

### If Write Index fails
Write State runs on its own branch, so a failed row
write can leave the watermark advanced past
messages that were never indexed. Recovery is
cheap: set `last_newpost_ts` / `last_releaseme_ts`
in `posty_state` back to the previous values and
re-run. Every write is idempotent — re-reading a
release is a no-op, proven in test-nodes.
